title: Claim-Size Fee Share Schedule, Harbison 5-Year and 10-Year Labor Protection
content:
On a Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection or Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection contract of Harbison Protection Contracts, the claim service fee for a service call carries a claim-size fee share. The claim-size fee share is set by the total amount approved on the original decisions of the contract's claims for the service call, as the contract's claim history shows. It applies by multiplication to the fee for the call.

| Total approved on the original decisions of the contract's claims for the call | Claim-size fee share |
|---|---|
| below $300.00 (the small-claim limit) | 0.50 |
| from $300.00 up to but not including $750.00 (the mid-claim limit) | 0.75 |
| $750.00 or more | 1 |

**Both sides of each limit.**

| Total approved | Share |
|---|---|
| $299.99 | 0.50 |
| $300.00 | 0.75 |
| $749.99 | 0.75 |
| $750.00 | 1 |

**Adding up a call (hypothetical).** Two claims on the same call: one approved for $260.00 and one approved for $180.00. The total is $440.00, which falls in the second band: share 0.75. A third claim on that call that was denied adds $0.00.
